content:
alex: Heads-up — RFC said we should avoid server-side shims, but a few customers asked for a vendored SDK compat layer to smooth migrations. Thoughts?

maria: I'm +1 for short-term vendored shim in SDK. Pros: faster, customers opt-in. Cons: maintenance burden, inconsistent behavior across SDK versions.

shreyas: Server-side shim keeps single source of truth. But we don't want to bloat runtime with legacy parsing logic. Also harder to test.

kate: Could we do a hybrid? tiny server-side fallback for critical headers + an SDK adapter lib for full surface. Rollout via feature flags.

alex: Hybrid seems pragmatic. Need concrete constraints: what surface does SDK adapter cover? request/response headers, streaming protocol, auth formats?

maria: Minimum: support old auth header X-Api-Key, old streaming chunk format (jsonlines with event=token), and legacy function-calling field names.

shreyas: Also add telemetry: server emits compat-warning events when it sees legacy payloads. SDK can swallow and report deprecation warnings to logs.

kate: Example shim in SDK: 
```js
// adapter:translateLegacy(req)
if (req.headers['x-api-key']) {
  req.headers.authorization = 'Bearer ' + req.headers['x-api-key']
  delete req.headers['x-api-key']
}
```

maria: Need test matrix: unit tests for each transform + e2e tests hitting dedicated infra with old client versions. Also perf tests — ensure latency impact <2ms.

alex: Deprecation timeline proposal: announce 6 months, SDK compat maintained for 12 months after deprecation, server-side minimal 18 months for critical customers. Thoughts?

shreyas: 6 months seems short. Many customers embed SDKs in apps and slow to update. Recommend 9 months announcement + 12 months SDK + 24 months server grace for enterprise.

kate: Can we short-circuit: update console to show which customers use legacy patterns and offer migration help? export list via query.

maria: Yes — add opt-in telemetry + migration dashboard. Also flag from billing to offer assisted migration for high-commit customers.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: /infra/compat-shim-ready -> CI green, perf <2ms, telemetry events in prod staging

alex: Action items:
- maria: draft announcement + deprecation policy doc (due 1w)
- shreyas: prototype server minimal fallback (2w)
- kate: SDK adapter POC & docstrings (2w)
- eng-sre (sam): run perf bench; add telemetry event schema (3w)

kate: lgtm. will open tracker tickets.

maria: :thumbsup: 

alex: Thanks all. We'll sync again Thu.
